response.sql: SELECT original_language_id, AVG(rental_rate / rental_duration) AS avg_rate_per_day, COUNT(*) AS film_count FROM film WHERE replacement_cost >= 20.99 GROUP BY original_language_id ORDER BY film_count DESC LIMIT 10

assumptions.assumption: The cutoff 20.99 is inclusive: films with replacement_cost >= 20.99 'meet the cutoff'.
Film count is COUNT(*) per group; film is already one row per film, and NULL original_language_id forms its own group via GROUP BY.
rental_rate / rental_duration is computed per film and then averaged; rental_rate is DECIMAL, so the division is assumed to yield a non-integer result (rental_duration is never 0 or NULL).

alternatives.interpretation: The cutoff is exclusive: keep only films with replacement_cost strictly greater than 20.99.
